title: Use Seedance 2.0 Mini or Seedance 2.0 4K by inputting a few swimsuit-girl…
content: Use Seedance 2.0 Mini or Seedance 2.0 4K by inputting a few swimsuit-girl images and letting the model auto-generate the video (“おまかせ”).
tips: Use Seedance 2.0 Mini or Seedance 2.0 4K by inputting a few swimsuit-girl images and letting the model auto-generate the video (“おまかせ”).

en.content: Use Seedance 2.0 Mini or Seedance 2.0 4K by inputting a few swimsuit-girl images and letting the model auto-generate the video (“omakase”).

es.content: Usa Seedance 2.0 Mini o Seedance 2.0 4K introduciendo unas cuantas imágenes de chicas en traje de baño y dejando que el modelo genere automáticamente el video (“おまかせ”).

fr.content: Utilisez Seedance 2.0 Mini ou Seedance 2.0 4K en saisissant quelques images de filles en maillot de bain et en laissant le modèle générer automatiquement la vidéo (« おまかせ »).

ko.content: 몇 장의 수영복 소녀 이미지를 입력하고 모델이 영상을 자동 생성하도록 맡기면(“おまかせ”), Seedance 2.0 Mini 또는 Seedance 2.0 4K를 사용할 수 있습니다.

pt.content: Use o Seedance 2.0 Mini ou o Seedance 2.0 4K enviando algumas imagens de garotas de biquíni e deixando o modelo gerar o vídeo automaticamente (“おまかせ”).

zh.content: 使用 Seedance 2.0 Mini 或 Seedance 2.0 4K，输入几张泳装女孩图片，让模型自动生成视频（“おまかせ”）。
